Cost 1 Conviction

Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Duration 1 minute

Saving Throw Will vs. your class DC

You read the other party its terms. On a failure the target is bound: whenever it damages your Ward during the duration, it takes mental damage equal to your level. On a critical failure it is also frightened 1 for as long as it is bound. On a success it is unaffected, and on a critical success it is immune to your Binding Clause Ascendant for 24 hours. Open to any Oath: the terms are your Oath's, whatever it is called.
